taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are preparing a groundwater site note for a borehole drilling team.

Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-08, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 225.6 | 4.98 | 4.98
2 | 217.6 | 7.63 | 12.61
3 | 626.8 | 19.10 | 31.71
4 | 694.3 | 0.32 | 32.03
5 | 580.5 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this station's curve as Q-type.

Write a short site report (under 150 words) for station T-08, covering the layer sequence and the curve type. End with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type_stated": "<letters>", "label_issue_flagged": true or false}
Set label_issue_flagged to true only if your report says the curve-type classification on file does not fit the layer values.

**Site Report – Station T-08, Survey Area T**

The interpreted VES model at T-08 comprises five layers. Resistivity decreases slightly from Layer 1 (225.6 Ω·m) to Layer 2 (217.6 Ω·m), then increases sharply through Layer 3 (626.8 Ω·m) and Layer 4 (694.3 Ω·m), before dropping to Layer 5 (580.5 Ω·m). Layer thicknesses are modest (≈5–19 m) except for a thin 0.32 m fourth layer, with the basal layer unbounded.

Applying the standard curve-type convention to the resistivity sequence (225.6, 217.6, 626.8, 694.3, 580.5):
- Layers 1-2-3: H (r1>r2<r3)
- Layers 2-3-4: A (r2<r3<r4)
- Layers 3-4-5: K (r3<r4>r5)

This yields an HAK-type curve, not a monotonically decreasing Q-type sequence. The on-file classification as Q-type does not match the resistivity values in the table and should be corrected or re-verified before use in drilling planning.

{"curve_type_stated": "HAK", "label_issue_flagged": true}
